title: On scalar nonlinear balance laws with singular nonlocal sources
summary: We investigate one-dimensional scalar balance laws with singular convolution-type source terms. Under appropriate convexity and kernel assumptions, we establish the global existence of entropy weak solutions in ${\bf L}^2(\mathbb{R})$, together with two partial uniqueness results, in the ${\bf L}^2$-periodic setting and non-periodic setting with ${\bf L}^1(\mathbb{R})$ kernel. In the ${\bf L}^1$-kernel case, the characteristic speed satisfies an Oleinik-type estimate, and entropy weak solutions possess locally bounded fractional variation for all positive times.
